authorizer_unavailable.description: 503 authorizer_unavailable: The permission service is unavailable; retry shortly.

bad_request.description: 400 bad_request: The request could not be read.

body_too_large.description: 413 body_too_large: The request body is larger than this server accepts.

exclusive_fields.description: 400 exclusive_fields: Two fields that cannot be set together are set.

forbidden.description: 403 forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.

internal.description: 500 internal: Something went wrong on this server.

invalid_field.description: 400 invalid_field: A field has a value it cannot take.

invalid_path.description: 400 invalid_path: That is not a path this server accepts.

length_required.description: 411 length_required: Send a Content-Length with the body.

link_read_only.description: 422 link_read_only: A link grants reading and nothing more.

missing_field.description: 400 missing_field: A required field is missing.

not_acceptable.description: 406 not_acceptable: This endpoint answers in JSON.

not_found.description: 404 not_found: There is no such object.

not_implemented.description: 501 not_implemented: This server does not serve that.

object_too_large.description: 413 object_too_large: The object is larger than this server accepts.

path_taken.description: 409 path_taken: Something already exists at that path.

precondition_failed.description: 412 precondition_failed: The object is not in the state the request required.

quota_exceeded.description: 413 quota_exceeded: This space has no room left.

rate_limited.description: 429 rate_limited: Too many requests; wait and retry.

storage_unavailable.description: 503 storage_unavailable: Storage is unavailable right now; retry shortly.

too_many_objects.description: 422 too_many_objects: The folder holds more objects than one copy accepts.

too_many_parts.description: 422 too_many_parts: The object needs more parts than this server allows.

unauthenticated.description: 401 unauthenticated: Sign in and send a valid token.

unknown_field.description: 400 unknown_field: The request body has a field this endpoint does not know.

unknown_plane.description: 400 unknown_plane: That path starts with a plane this server does not serve.

unsupported_media_type.description: 415 unsupported_media_type: Send the body as JSON.

Error.description: The one error shape of this API. A caller branches on error.code and shows error.message.

code.description: The stable identifier of the row of the error table.

details.description: What varies: always request_id, the developer sentence in detail, and the field paths at fault in fields.

message.description: The one sentence of that row, fixed and shown to a person.

Page.description: The one shape every list route answers. next_cursor is present only when a further page exists.

bearer.description: A token from an issuer this installation lists, carrying the audience it verifies.

info.description: Durable storage for people, agents, and sandboxes: files with versions, trash and stars, folders deleted and copied in one call, uploads in parts, shares with a permission ladder and public links, and an event log.
